{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: CI
on: [push]
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@ba0d7d2ec06a0ea1cb5fa41b2e4a3ab91d21278a # v9.3.0
        with:
          version: v2.1
        env:
          VERBOSE: "true"

  tidy:
    name: Tidy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: Check if mods are tidy
        run: make check-tidy

  test-go:
    name: Go Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: Run Go tests
        run: make test-go
        env:
          VERBOSE: "true"

  test-ruby:
    name: Ruby Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@95ef2b042f9d7a56d8268cba8559e2842e2ad01b # v1.321.0
        with:
          ruby-version: "3.3"
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Run Ruby tests
        run: make test-ruby

  release-please:
    name: Release Please
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' || github.ref_name == 'master' }}
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: jimeh/release-please-manifest-action@dfe8992173f2f25b47e88ba812615383db902185 # v4.0.0
        with:
          app-id: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_BOT_APP_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_BOT_PRIVATE_KEY }}",
  "rationale": "The three Go jobs (lint, tidy, test-go) repeatedly fetch Go modules on every run with no dependency cache, while go.mod/go.sum exist as stable cache inputs. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and its measured Go-module example support adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') after setup-go and before build/test steps. Ruby already uses bundler-cache: true, and release-please needs no Go cache, so changes are minimal and preserve all checks and permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
